title: Witness Tampering and Retaliation
grade_or_penalty: 3rd degree; 2nd degree if force or threat of force is used; 1st degree in connection with a 1st-degree crime
key_points: Knowingly trying to induce a witness or informant to testify falsely, withhold testimony, elude legal process or not appear.
Retaliating against a witness or informant for lawful conduct.
